title: Coinbase Launches AI Trading for US 500 and Crypto Perpetuals

tickers.name: Coinbase Global, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Traders can now automate positions on more than 20 crypto tokens and several financial indices by connecting their AI assistants to Coinbase. An update to the Coinbase for Agents tool allows software bots to execute long and short trades on perpetual contracts, including those based on the top 500 US equities, the 100 largest tech stocks, and top holdings in China, AI, and aerospace and defense.

This expansion of the platform's AiFi capabilities integrates with Composio, which connects AI agents to over 1,500 apps for multi-app asset management workflows. CEO Brian Armstrong recently urged developers to have their agents submit feedback via a dedicated API to identify where transactions get stuck. Index perpetuals are available only to users based in the United States.
